item: R663 upload and merge media types
summary: POST /api/newsletters/import and /api/documents/pdf/upload answer 415 to anything but multipart/form-data (before the form is read or the newsletter source row is created); POST /api/diagnostics/source-qualification-merge answers 415 to anything but multipart or url-encoded, so an empty or text/plain POST no longer runs the merge. Depth behind the Origin layer. Stated limit: any multipart POST still reaches all three, any url-encoded POST the merge, and an empty multipart POST still get-or-creates the newsletter source row.
